hits.snippet: # Swiggy Instamart CEO Amitesh Kumar Jha resigns; Nandita Sinha to take charge from August 3 ## Leadership transition at Swiggy's quick commerce business as Amitesh Kumar Jha steps down to pursue other opportunities. Swiggy has announced a leadership change at its quick commerce arm Instamart, with Chief Executive Officer Amitesh Kumar Jha stepping down and Nandita Sinha set to take over the role from August 3, according to a regulatory filing made on Tuesday. The company also announced the appointment of Nandita Sinha as the new Chief Executive Officer of Instamart.
